description: DYNAMIC TABLE DDL through the SQL surface - SHOW DYNAMIC TABLES cells (target_lag, refresh_mode, scheduling_state ACTIVE/SUSPENDED, warehouse, comment, the definition column named text) and DESCRIBE DYNAMIC TABLE answering the COLUMN list: lag canonicalization ('1 minutes' reads back singular, '90 seconds' decomposes to '1 minute, 30 seconds'), AUTO resolving to INCREMENTAL, DOWNSTREAM, sub-minute lags refused quoting the input (creating nothing), COMMENT only before AS, OR REPLACE and IF NOT EXISTS, DROP (IF EXISTS), SUSPEND/RESUME/REFRESH, SET TARGET_LAG/WAREHOUSE/COMMENT/DOWNSTREAM/DATA_RETENTION (REFRESH_MODE refused as fixed at creation), SHOW listings and state, and dynamic tables appearing in SHOW OBJECTS as kind TABLE with is_dynamic Y. Converted from features/DynamicTableTest; its three engine-catalog readbacks (INITIALIZE, data retention days, last-refresh time - no SQL read surface) stay in the trimmed Java class, with their SQL statements smoke-covered here.
